root_cause.text: Missing bounds check on the user-supplied pat_index value before using it as an array index into `xe->pat.table` in the madvise IOCTL handler, allowing an out-of-bounds kernel read.
root_cause.evidence: The commit message states "The vulnerability exists because the validation in madvise_args_are_sane() directly calls xe_pat_index_get_coh_mode(xe, args->pat_index.val) without first checking if pat_index is within [0, xe->pat.n_entries)." The patch adds `if (XE_IOCTL_DBG(xe, args->pat_index.val >= xe->pat.n_entries)) return false;` before the array access.
